items.briefing:
Australians are being warned about active scams impersonating myGov and using fake invoices, according to security firm Proofpoint. Separately, the National Anti-Scam Centre has reached out to over 10,000 Australians caught up in an international cryptocurrency scam investigation — if you receive contact from them, take it seriously and follow their guidance.

On the broader security front, a new Australian startup called Bugtri has launched in Sydney to help reduce low-quality AI-generated vulnerability reports, while warnings continue that many businesses are adopting AI faster than they have proper rules in place to govern it safely.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected myGov message or invoice by email, don't click any links — log in directly through your browser instead.

featured.title: Proofpoint warns of myGov & invoice scams in Australia
featured.quote: Australians lost AUD $2.18 billion to scams in 2025, with myGov impersonation as primary vector.
